blocks.task_summary: Solve the differential equation dy/dx = y^2 cos^2 x to find the value of a in the solution form y = a/(2x + sin 2x + b).
method_path: Separate variables: ∫ y^{-2} dy = ∫ cos^2 x dx
Compare with given form to obtain a = -4

evidence.basis: attempt to separate variables (M1); ∫ y^{-2} dy = ∫ cos^2 x dx; attempt to use an identity for cos^2 x (M1); (1/2)(1+cos2x); -1/y = 1/2(x + 1/2 sin 2x) + C A1A1; -1/y = (2x + sin 2x)/4 + C OR y = -4/(2x + sin 2x + C) (A1); a = -4 A1

blocks.task_summary: Given y = 1 when x = π/2, find the value of b using the solution from part (a).
method_path: Substitute x = π/2, y = 1 into y = -4/(2x + sin 2x + b)
Solve for b: 1 = -4/(π + 0 + b) → b = -4 - π

evidence.basis: attempt to substitute initial conditions with their a (M1); 1 = -4/(π + 0 + b); b = -4 - π A1
